{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.18

|branch= diag

|gr1= Diagnostic

|descr= Dumps the bytecode as {{arma3}} sees it, in a diff friendly way. Useful for testing custom [[SQF Bytecode|SQFC]] compilers. 

|s1= [[diag_SQFCDebugDump]] [sourcePath, targetPath]

|p1= sourcePath: [[String]] - Path to file on drive that should be read

|p2= targetPath: [[String]] - Path to file on drive to output to

|r1= [[Code]] - compiled expression (If parsing was successful)

|x1= <sqf>diag_SQFCDebugDump ["P:/test.sqfc", "P:/dump"];</sqf>

|seealso=
}}
